articles.title: No, Seriously, Democratic Socialists Want to Abolish the Senate
articles.author: Rochester Red Star: News from Rochester DSA
articles.content_excerpt: by Gregory Lebens-Higgins On July 14, 2026, the national body of the Democratic Socialists of America released Workers Deserve More, a program outlining the organization’s goals and values. Workers Deserve More was drafted by a committee consisting of members of the National Political Committee, leaders of other national committees, and rank and file members following a process outlined by a resolution passed at DSA’s 2025 National Convention . Upon its release, Workers Deserve More received significant attention in mainstream media. The coverage has provided free advertising for DSA’s popular demands such as universal healthcare, improved working conditions, and replacing the two-party system with a multi-party democracy. articles.title: India’s Gen Z Protests Are Breaking the Grip of Fear
articles.author: Ashok Kumbamu
articles.content_excerpt: “I swear, I can die in peace now. I can die smiling.” Coming from the renowned writer and activist Arundhati Roy , these words are startling. For more than three decades, Roy has stood alongside people fighting to protect their land, their homes, and their rights from destructive development projects, state repression, and policies imposed in the name of national growth. She has seen movements rise and victories won, but she has also seen resistance criminalized, promises broken, dreams crushed, and hopes worn down. And yet watching India’s Gen Z take to the streets, Roy seemed to glimpse something she had almost stopped expecting: hope. articles.title: Trump Family Prediction Market Conflicts Are a Good Bet
articles.author: David Moscrop
articles.content_excerpt: There’s nothing to see here, folks. Don’t believe your lying eyes. The eldest son of the president of the United States and his investment firm, 1789 Capital, are raising money in a funding round for Polymarket, the gambling website that styles itself a “prediction market” and which DonaldTrump Jr’s firm values at $21 billion. But it’s a nothingburger. Really. Except, if the relationship seems suspect on its face, that’s because it is. Trump Jr and his company stress that there’s a thick, heavy wall between his political connections — for instance, his father, the president — and his business activities. articles.title: Tyson Shuttered a Plant and Laid Off 2,500 Workers Overnight
articles.author: Caitlyn Clark
articles.content_excerpt: Ouano Tante worked the afternoon shift at the Tyson beef plant in Joslin, Illinois, for five years. But when she and hundreds of her coworkers arrived at work on August 14, they found the plant closed. They speculated that someone on the morning shift might have gotten injured. Then two mid-level supervisors came outside in tears. Plant supervisors told workers the plant was closing permanently, effective immediately. Inside, the early-morning shift had just ended when the workers were informed it would be their last. The cafeteria erupted into chaos . Plant supervisors stood guard by the doors, workers said, while everyone received their closure paperwork. “People were crying, shaking,” Tante said. “When we were leaving the parking lot, there were so many car accidents.
